text:
olivia: proposing an operator-inbox pattern for auto-fallbacks: batch low-severity fallbacks into an inbox item instead of immediate alerts. reduces pager noise.

ben: agree. inbox should show route, delta (from->to sample_rate), primary trigger tag, and link to audit. escalate only if inbox item marked urgent.

maria: add per-route quiet_window and per-team thresholds. default quiet_window 10m. also need runbook_url on the policy so inbox can prefill guidance.

ashwin: backend: emit aggregated event per window with counts_by_trigger. include decayed_sample_rate so UI can show trend. provide short trace_id pointer, not full blob.

leah: UI: inbox item with three states (muted/digest/urgent). badge on route list showing recent digest count and a sparkline of decayed_sample_rate. inspect opens condensed audit drawer with actions: simulate / create incident (permissioned) / pin.

sam: telemetry fields minimal: event_id, ts, route_id, tenant_id, sample_from, sample_to, window_mins, triggers[], counts_by_trigger, decayed_sample_rate, top_trace_id, deploy_ids[], explainable(bool). add human_action_required bool.

ops-bot: draft spec created at https://internal/specs/fallback-inbox-events.md. sample payload included in draft. Review requested: @leah @sam.

maria: retention/export: aggregated inbox defaults 60d, full audit 90d. export to S3 with PII scrubbing and RBAC.

ashwin: implementation tasks: emitter for staging, grouping logic for digest, signed short-lived trace URLs for private deployments.

olivia: action items:
- ashwin: prototype emitter + grouping rules by Fri
- ops-bot: finalize spec with example inbox payloads and paging rules
- leah/sam: quick mockups for inbox + drawer + pin flow by Wed
- maria: finalize retention/export and privacy notes
- ben: add CLI/SDK patch example to docs for runtime sample_rate tweaks

ben: final: allow per-tenant opt-out of notifications while keeping audit rows.

olivia: thanks all, well run a 2-week canary on 10% of routes and measure fold_rate. :rocket:
